meta.name: LINK CLICK
meta.description: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!

videos.title: Emma
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang accept a job requiring them to uncover financial information hidden in a photograph. Entering the past through the body of overworked employee Emma, Cheng must follow Lu Guang’s instructions and avoid altering events, but experiencing her loneliness and family struggles makes remaining detached increasingly difficult.

videos.title: Secret Recipe
videos.overview: Restaurant owner Yu Xia hires Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to recover a secret recipe kept by Lin Zhen, her former friend and business partner. With few useful clues available, Cheng dives into an old photograph and witnesses the history behind their successful restaurant, uncovering a deeply personal conflict beneath their bitter separation.

videos.title: To Lose, Not To Win
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi enters a photograph from client Chen Xiao’s high-school days to deliver words he never shared with his basketball teammates. When an accident forces him into a crucial match that could determine the club’s future, Cheng must resist his competitive instincts and obey Lu Guang’s strict instruction: lose the game, no matter what.

videos.title: Confess
videos.overview: After accidentally changing the outcome of Chen Xiao’s basketball game, Cheng Xiaoshi continues delivering his client’s long-unspoken messages to friends and family. As the mission proceeds almost too smoothly, a troubling realization about the date reveals that something far more serious is approaching.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: Knowing that a devastating earthquake is approaching, Cheng Xiaoshi desperately tries to warn Chen Xiao’s friends and the surrounding villagers, but no one believes him. Refusing to give up, he asks Lu Guang to help save Chen Xiao’s mother as the two confront the painful limits of changing the past.

videos.title: Search of the Child
videos.overview: A desperate father asks the Time Photo Studio to investigate the disappearance of his young son, Doudou, who vanished three years earlier. Despite the emotional toll of his previous mission, Cheng Xiaoshi enters surveillance footage from the day of the abduction and attempts to trace the child without disturbing the past.

videos.title: Aunt May
videos.overview: After losing sight of Doudou during their first attempt, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang discover a photograph taken by the child on the day he vanished. Entering Doudou’s body, Cheng experiences the abduction firsthand and must identify the kidnapper and uncover his location before the twelve-hour limit expires.

videos.title: Lost Signal
videos.overview: Xu Shanshan asks the studio to recover what her longtime friend Dong Yi told her during a drunken university gathering. While reliving the night through her photograph, Cheng Xiaoshi notices something unsettling and becomes distracted from the original assignment, drawing him into a mystery that may be more dangerous than it first appears.

videos.title: Consequence of Goodwill
videos.overview: After a disturbing call from Xu Shanshan’s phone leaves her unreachable, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling fear she may be in danger. While Lu Guang seeks help from the police, Cheng discovers a photograph connected to the case and impulsively dives into it alone, hoping to uncover the truth before it is too late.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: With Xu Shanshan still missing, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling begin searching for clues on their own. When a photograph connected to her disappearance offers a possible lead, Cheng ignores Lu Guang’s warning and enters the image, determined to uncover what happened before the situation grows even more dangerous.

videos.title: Pinnacle of Light
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi puts a dangerous plan into motion to expose the person threatening those around the studio. As the confrontation unfolds, Emma’s unresolved fate continues to haunt him, leading him back into the past for one final attempt to reach her—while an unseen danger remains closer than anyone realizes.

videos.title: Falling
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi returns to the photo studio to find Lu Guang critically wounded and Qiao Ling under the control of a mysterious enemy. Desperate to save them both, he tries to discover how to break the possession, but the arrival of the police leaves him detained as the investigation takes a troubling new direction.

videos.title: Night Raid
videos.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi and the others investigate the mysterious enemy’s connection to photographs, Officer Chen Bin suddenly disappears along with a crucial piece of evidence. Meanwhile, Qian Jin pays an unexpected visit to Chen Bin’s home, while a coordinated nighttime assault places Lu Guang and those guarding him in immediate danger.

videos.title: Two Funerals
videos.overview: Following the hospital attack, Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling struggle with its emotional aftermath while Captain Xiao faces growing pressure surrounding the investigation. As two funerals bring grief, suspicion and unresolved questions to the surface, Cheng considers using his abilities to offer comfort to those left behind.

videos.title: Them In The Photo
videos.overview: As Captain Xiao reveals a troubling incident from Qian Jin’s past, the group learns that a mysterious visitor left Lu Guang a photograph bearing a cryptic message. Hoping it will provide clues about their enemy, Cheng Xiaoshi enters the image and finds himself experiencing the unfamiliar life of a young girl.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: While exploring the photograph left behind for the group, Cheng Xiaoshi experiences the difficult childhood of two siblings and searches their family life for clues. As tensions build around an evening meal, he struggles to remain detached from events that may hold the key to the mystery unfolding in the present.

videos.title: Li Tianxi
videos.overview: After witnessing the twins’ traumatic childhood, Cheng Xiaoshi is abruptly pulled out of the photograph and returns to the present. At the police station, he meets a mysterious witness connected to the investigation, hoping their conversation will clarify the growing threat surrounding the studio and reveal what truly happened to Li Tianxi.

videos.title: Urban Warfare
videos.overview: When Li Tianxi takes Cheng Xiaoshi from the police station, Captain Xiao and Qiao Ling race through the city to find him, only to be confronted by Qian Jin’s men. Meanwhile, Lu Guang disappears from his guarded hospital room, as the pursuit erupts into a dangerous battle across the streets.

videos.title: Hostage
videos.overview: Lu Guang’s unexpected intervention prevents Cheng Xiaoshi from being taken away, but the rescue places him in danger instead. As Cheng and the others regroup, Captain Xiao reveals new information connecting Qian Jin to the twins’ tragic past, giving their investigation an increasingly personal and dangerous direction.

videos.title: Three Stories
videos.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi’s journey through the past continues, three interconnected stories reveal the events that brought Qian Jin and the Li twins together. Each account sheds new light on the tragedies and choices that shaped them, while Cheng faces a crucial decision that could change the course of the present.

videos.title: Improvise
videos.overview: After learning more about the twins’ abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and his allies devise a risky plan to rescue Lu Guang from Qian Jin and Li Tianchen. As both sides prepare for a hostage exchange, Cheng must adapt quickly when their carefully arranged strategy begins to unravel.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: During the tense hostage exchange, Cheng Xiaoshi’s carefully prepared rescue plan collides with Qian Jin’s countermeasures. Separated from his allies and drawn deeper into the theatre, Cheng faces a dangerous demand involving his powers and Qian Jin’s past, while the confrontation pushes everyone toward a decisive final clash.

videos.title: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
videos.overview: As the confrontation reaches its climax, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Captain Xiao fight to stop Qian Jin, while the Li twins face the consequences of their painful past. With loyalties shifting and unexpected powers entering the struggle, everyone must decide how far they will go to protect the person they cannot bear to lose.

videos.title: So Time Begins to Flow Again
videos.overview: Following a devastating attack, Lu Guang returns to the time when he first met Cheng Xiaoshi, determined to prevent the future he witnessed. As he relives the beginning of their friendship, a series of seemingly ordinary encounters begins setting their shared destiny in motion once again.

videos.title: Prelude
videos.overview: While Liu Xiao becomes trapped in a dangerous wager at a Bridon bar, Cheng Xiaoshi discovers a photograph apparently sent by his missing father. Believing it may provide a clue about his parents, he decides to travel to Bridon, despite Qiao Ling’s strong objections.

videos.title: Them
videos.overview: Following clues connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents, he and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon and visit a bar popular with football supporters. There they meet the friendly Xia Fei, but an impulsive celebration provokes a rival group and draws the three into a dangerous chase through the city.

videos.title: And Then There Were None
videos.overview: After Xia Fei’s enigmatic boss, Vein, rescues the group from their pursuers, Lu Guang becomes suspicious of their new ally. Cheng Xiaoshi later returns to the bar seeking information about BAHATI, where he uncovers a connection to a language school destroyed in a devastating fire ten years earlier.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang search for anyone who survived the disaster. Their investigation leads Cheng into a photograph belonging to Wang Qing, a gifted student trapped in a difficult situation, where he uncovers a personal connection that may bring him closer to the truth about his father.

videos.title: Puzzle
videos.overview: To earn Vein’s help in locating Wang Qing, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang agree to replace a missing model at a photo shoot. Their unusual payment leads them to Wang Qing’s mental health clinic, where her psychological tests begin raising unsettling questions about the people and hidden motives surrounding their investigation.

videos.title: The Forgotten Past
videos.overview: An adoptive father, an old photo, and the day two powers first crossed paths.

videos.title: The Caged Beast
videos.overview: Searching for Xia Fei means going where no one looks. That has never stopped Cheng Xiaoshi.

videos.title: Bloodbath in Laos
videos.overview: Faced with a crisis, can Cheng Xiaoshi save Xia Fei, or will help come from someone else?

videos.title: Jae
videos.overview: A mysterious visitor from Bridon disrupts the photo studio's peace. What has he come for?

videos.title: Welcome Banquet
videos.overview: Over a steaming hot pot feast, rival factions quietly begin to clash.

videos.title: Testing the Waters
videos.overview: A forgotten childhood photo resurfaces in a test across time and space. But who is the real prey?

videos.title: Chinatown Investigation
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi possesses a young Vein and encounters Xia Fei's father in Chinatown, uncovering a cruel truth.

videos.title: Blood-Red Storm
videos.overview: The secret behind the Chinatown family massacre.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Xia Fei's intentions are revealed, along with Lu Guang's motives.

videos.title: Misplaced Redemption
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi relives lost memories and discovers that the past he wants to save is already broken

videos.title: The Vanishing Exit
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi jumps between photos as the paths back to the present close one by one.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: Trapped between memories and photographs, Cheng Xiaoshi searches for a way back.
